newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka closes steady in quiet market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka closes steady in quiet market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka finished mostly steady at 42.5470/5490 to the dollar in a quiet session of interbank market against the previous close at 42.5460/5490, dealers said.
The local unit was quoted at 42.5460/5495 in early trade and remained almost rangebound, they said.
"Turnover was low as leading market players were reluctant in trading," said one dealer.
The interbank call money rates closed flat at 4.5 percent to 5.5 percent, dealers said. -- Dhaka Newsroom 880-2-506363
